title: 64c88ae4/T1: Benchmark container image + fflas-ffpack/M4RI reference harnesses
description:
First task of story `64c88ae4`. Produces the reproducible container image and the reference-library benchmark harnesses. Emits CSV baseline numbers.

## Deliverables

- **`benchmarks/Containerfile`** — Debian-slim + pinned gcc, OpenBLAS, GMP, Givaro, fflas-ffpack, M4RI. `-O3 -march=native` throughout. (Renamed from `Dockerfile` per user directive 2026-04-26: the host runs **rootless podman**, for which `Containerfile` is the canonical file name.)
- **`benchmarks/image.lock`** — image digest pinned for reproducibility. (Renamed from `Dockerfile.lock` to match the `Containerfile` rename; the `.lock` suffix-style file is podman/buildah-idiomatic.)
- **`benchmarks/run.sh`** — launches the container, captures host info in `benchmarks/host.txt`, runs the reference harnesses, drops CSV.
- **`benchmarks/reference/fflas_bench.cpp`** — invokes fflas-ffpack `fgemm`, PLE, echelon, inv, solve, charpoly on identical seeded matrices for every (field, size) combination from the story.
- **`benchmarks/reference/m4ri_bench.c`** — invokes M4RI matmul on GF(2) matrices (seeded identical to the gf2 side).
- **CSV schema documented** in `benchmarks/README.md` — columns: `(lib, operation, field, m, k, n, rank_regime, seed, wall_ns, throughput_ops)`.

## Success criteria

- [hard] Container builds from a clean state with the pinned `Containerfile`. Validated out-of-gate via `./benchmarks/run.sh` or `./benchmarks/smoke.sh` on a real host (the gate runner has no podman); `cargo-ci` does not exercise this path.
- [hard] Harnesses run to completion and emit CSV for every (field, op, size, rank_regime) cell listed in the coverage table of `benchmarks/README.md`. Cells that exceed the per-cell wall-clock cap (`kCellBudgetNs`, 30 s in `fflas_bench.cpp`) are still emitted with an `early_exit` warning on stderr.
- [hard] Host hardware captured in `host.txt` at run time.
- [hard] Bench seeds are deterministic; rerun produces identical matrices (even if timings differ). The shared SplitMix64 derivation lives in `benchmarks/reference/seed_helpers.h` so the C and C++ harnesses cannot drift.
- [hard] Container image works on a host that has *no* fflas-ffpack / M4RI installed natively — i.e., nothing leaks from the host.

## Amendment (R1, 2026-04-26)

Original deliverables named `Dockerfile` / `Dockerfile.lock`; renamed to `Containerfile` / `image.lock` to match the host's rootless-podman runtime. Behaviour-equivalent.

The following coverage cells are formally deferred from T1 to a future ticket, with rationale:

- **PLUQ / RowEchelonForm / Invert / Solve / CharPoly at `n = 4096`.** Each cell is multi-second per iteration on most reference fields; running the full sweep would dominate the T1 wall-clock budget by ~100×. The `fgemm@4096` point is preserved on every GF(p) field as the most representative large-cell throughput (BLAS3, peak microarchitecture utilisation). T2 will land the heavy ops at 4096 with a relaxed per-cell budget.
- **Rectangular fgemm** (skew aspect ratios for the Winograd-crossover sweep). The CSV schema's `(m, k, n)` columns already accommodate it; T2 implementation only.
- **Sparse SpMV at sparsity 1% / 5%, n in {1024, 4096}.** fflas-ffpack's sparse interface is via LinBox proper, not fflas-ffpack itself; tracked under sibling story `8a90882e`.
- **Native `Modular<int8_t>` path.** fflas-ffpack does not ship an int8 Modular template upstream; `Modular<float>` over `[0, 251)` is the canonical small-prime path used in the LinBox test corpus and is what we reference. A native int8 wrapper is not on the critical path.
- **`Givaro::GFq` for GF(2^m).** Givaro's GF(2^m) goes through Modular<float> with a polynomial-multiplication wrapper; this is not a fair comparison to gf2's PCLMULQDQ kernels. T2 will add a Givaro::GFq harness if a fair-comparison framing is found.

Coverage that **was** added in R1 (against the original story matrix):
- charpoly extended to all four GF(p) fields (was: two).
- `fgemm@4096` added on every GF(p) field.
- `Invert` and `Solve` now run in both `uniform` and `deficient` (rank = n/2) regimes.
- Per-cell 30-second wall-clock cap with `early_exit` annotation on cells that exceed it.
- SSOT shared C/C++ header (`benchmarks/reference/seed_helpers.h`) for the SplitMix64 seed-derivation scheme.

## Depends on

- None (can start in parallel with T2).
